Account Creation & Eligibility To establish a ShopEase customer account, an individual must be at least 18 years of age (or have explicit parental/legal guardian supervision under Indian contract law) and possess a valid Indian mobile phone number capable of receiving SMS OTPs and an active email address. REGISTRATION RULE Rule: Each ShopEase account must be uniquely associated with one mobile number and one email address. Duplicate registration attempts using an existing verified mobile number will be redirected to account sign-in or password recovery. 2. Credential Verification & Security Standards Email Verification: Upon registration, an automated activation link is dispatched to the specified email address. The link remains valid for 24 hours. Unverified emails will prompt a verification banner upon subsequent logins. Phone Verification: A 6-digit One-Time Password (OTP) is sent via SMS. The OTP is valid for 10 minutes and expires automatically. A maximum of 3 OTP generation requests are permitted within any rolling 60-minute window to prevent automated abuse. Account Modifications, Phone/Email Changes & Recovery Customers can modify their profile details through the 'My Account > Security Settings' section: • Updating Mobile Number: Changing the registered phone number requires dual-factor OTP validation sent simultaneously to the existing phone number and the proposed new phone number. • Updating Email Address: Requires entering the current account password followed by clicking a cryptographic confirmation link sent to the new email address. • Account Recovery: If a customer loses access to both their registered phone number and email address, they must initiate formal identity recovery through customer support (support@shopease.example). The user must supply past order IDs, registered address history, and government-issued photo identification. 4. Account Suspension, Deactivation & Permanent Erasure • Suspension: ShopEase reserves the right to suspend accounts engaged in abusive return velocity, payment chargeback fraud, repeated abusive language toward support personnel, or automated bot scraping. AUTHORITATIVE CANCELLATION RULE Rule: Customers can cancel an order free of charge before the order reaches 'Shipped' status. No cancellation fees, administrative deductions, or penalty charges apply to any order cancelled prior to shipment. 2. Handling Cancellations After Shipment Once an order transitions to 'Shipped' status, the consignment is in the physical custody of our third-party logistics courier network and its routing cannot be instantly halted via the user interface. In such situations: 1. Doorstep Refusal: When the delivery executive arrives or contacts you for delivery, inform them that you wish to cancel the order and decline acceptance. 2. Return to Origin (RTO): The courier updates the delivery status to 'Refused by Customer - RTO Initiated'. 3. Automated Refund Trigger: Upon physical return of the package to our fulfillment hub, a 100% refund is automatically released to your original payment method. Remaining uncancelled items proceed to fulfillment without interruption. Any pro-rated delivery or coupon threshold adjustments are recalculated automatically. System Auto-Cancellations: Orders pending online payment verification for more than 15 minutes, or orders with unverifiable, incomplete delivery addresses that fail phone confirmation, will be automatically cancelled by the system. 5. Minimum Order Value (MOV), Expiration & Exclusions Minimum Order Value (MOV): The MOV represents the net value of eligible merchandise required in the shopping basket before taxes and shipping fees are calculated. Promotional Expiration: All promotional coupons possess strict validity dates and times (evaluated in Indian Standard Time, IST). Expired coupon codes cannot be reactivated or extended by customer support personnel. Category Exclusions: Unless explicitly indicated in special promotional terms, coupon discounts cannot be redeemed against the purchase of bullion (gold/silver coins), infant formula, digital gift cards, or ShopEase Plus/Premium membership subscriptions.
